name: Earth Elemental Myrmidon (A)
languages: one language of its creator's choice

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The myrmidon's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The myrmidon makes two maul attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Strike (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The myrmidon makes one maul attack. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 16 (3d10) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
